issue.title: Plan Decisions: typed reviewer choices answered inside the plan review
issue.description: A tale or epic can declare up to five typed, defaulted Plan Decisions (toggles, 2-5-way choices, and memory consents) in a `decisions:` frontmatter map. The reviewer answers them in the same plan review on ACE, Telegram, or the CLI, and the primary action always approves exactly the values on display. `%auto` takes verified defaults and posts a quiet receipt. Answers are recorded once in the gate response and stamped into the archived plan. Every implementer receives them mechanically, and a plan authorizes a memory edit only through an accepted memory decision.
